mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT role as key, COUNT(*) as value FROM user_info WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY role

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') as label, COUNT(*) as value FROM user_info WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(created_at), '-W', WEEK(created_at, 1)) as label, COUNT(*) as value FROM user_info WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND CONCAT(YEAR(created_at), '-W', WEEK(created_at, 1)) BETWEEN #{startWeek} AND #{endWeek} GROUP BY YEAR(created_at), WEEK(created_at, 1) ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT AVG(registration_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(ar.id) as registration_count FROM user_info u LEFT JOIN activity_registration ar ON u.id = ar.user_id WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.id ) as counts

SELECT CASE WHEN registration_count = 0 THEN '0' WHEN registration_count BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN '1-5' WHEN registration_count BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10' WHEN registration_count BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20' ELSE '20+' END as key, COUNT(*) as value FROM ( SELECT u.id, COUNT(ar.id) as registration_count FROM user_info u LEFT JOIN activity_registration ar ON u.id = ar.user_id WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.id ) as counts GROUP BY key
